api: Brex Platform REST API (https://platform.brexapis.com, documented at https://api.brex.com per developer.brex.com); provider artifact version: OpenAPI 3.0.1; product API info versions 0.1-1.0.0-alpha/beta
scope: Exact existing-surface evidence fallback: the preserved source inventory contains 108 official-survey operation entries, exactly matching the immutable count. Shared executable bindings for the same provider method/path are merged into one normalized endpoint. The cited official html_reference artifact is retained as the v2 provenance root; no operation was inferred from a documentation crawl. Prior source-surface scope: Pass B full-surface expansion against the live published per-product OpenAPI bundles (developer.brex.com/_bundle/openapi/{transactions,expenses,team,payments,webhooks,budgets,accounting,fields,onboarding,travel}_api.yaml, 108 method+path operations across 10 API products, fetched 2026-07-04): 16 read streams (transactions, users, expenses, vendors, budgets, departments, locations, titles, legal_entities, cards, accounts_card, accounts_cash, card_statements, linked_accounts, transfers, webhooks) and 14 write actions covering vendor/department/location/title/user/card/expense/webhook lifecycle mutations. Excluded: EVERY write endpoint whose OpenAPI definition marks the Idempotency-Key request header required:true (create_vendor, create_transfer, create_incoming_transfer, create_card, create/update budget and spend_limit at both v1 and v2, create_webhook, create_webhook_group) as requires_elevated_scope ENGINE_GAP entries — engine.WriteAction has no headers field and write.go's executeWriteRecord calls Requester.Do/DoForm with an unconditional nil headers argument, so this dialect cannot attach ANY header, let alone a fresh-per-request idempotency key, to a write request; the surrounding update/delete/lock/unlock/terminate actions on the same resources ARE modeled since Brex marks Idempotency-Key optional on those. Also excluded: the entire Travel API (a distinct product, no consuming stream), Accounting API (Brex's own outbound accounting-sync integration surface, not card/expense/vendor data), Fields API (custom-field schema/value management, account-schema-adjacent), Onboarding/referrals API (partner-onboarding, unrelated to financial-data sync), webhook groups (a partner multi-tenant fan-out feature this single-account connector does not use), the deprecated v1 Budgets surface (superseded by the v2 budgets stream already covered), and v2 spend_limits (Brex models spend limits as budgets with limit_type=budget — same underlying record shape the budgets stream already reads) as out_of_scope/deprecated/duplicate_of breadth-vs-cost triage; single-object detail endpoints duplicating an already-covered list stream, PCI-scoped card-PAN/webhook-signing-secret reads, and non-data endpoints (company/current-user identity snapshots) round out the exclusion set.
